facts.label: Instruções e conselhos
facts.sub: Use o imperativo para instruções: Pick up the bottles. Use should + verbo base para conselhos: You should wear gloves. Use Let’s para convidar.

facts.label: Instruções
facts.sub: Para dar uma instrução, use o verbo no começo da frase: Pick up the bottles. Put it in the bin. Não use you nem -s. Adicione please para ficar mais gentil.

facts.label: Conselhos
facts.sub: Para dar um conselho, use should + verbo base: You should wear gloves. A forma é a mesma para I, you, he, she, we e they.

pages.title: A long beach · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning on a long beach in Portland. The sea is blue, but the sand has trash. Nina stands near a blue bin. Her neighbor Blake walks over with a bag. Many people want to help today. Blake asks what to do first.
“Hi, Nina! The beach is full of trash today.” says Blake. “Yes. Pick up the bottles, please. Let’s start here.” says Nina. “OK. Take a bag and put the cans in it.” says Blake.
